learning_objective: 🎯 Let us explore how to accurately measure and compare distances to find out what is super close and what is really far away!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Things that take only a few steps to reach are near to us, like your TV. Things that take a long time to reach, like the moon or another country, are very far!
We use small units like centimeters for a pencil, meters for a school playground, and large kilometers for measuring roads between faraway cities.
By checking which number is bigger, we can easily compare distances. If the park is 2 km away and the zoo is 10 km away, the zoo is much farther!

fun_activity.title: 🔭 Far and Near Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Look out of your biggest window at home. Write down three things that are very near to you and three things that look super far away in the sky or down the street!

quick_recap: ⭐ We measure small things with centimeters and super long distances with kilometers.
⭐ Comparing numbers helps us quickly figure out which place is closer to us.
⭐ Estimating distances helps us guess if something is near or far!
